info.name: Batata Kachrya
info.description: Marinated potato slices coated with semolina & flour then deep fried. quick and easy popular Maharashtrian snacks. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Egg Pakoda
info.description: Very famous Indian snack that involves coating boiled eggs with a besan batter and then deep fried until golden brown. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Onion Bhaji
info.description: Deep fried onion fritters, It's a simple and delicious dish, commonly known as Kanda Bhaji in Maharashtra. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Batata Bhaji
info.description: Deep fried potato fritters, one more delicious snacks / veg starter which is very famous in Maharashtrian families. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Paneer Pakoda
info.description: Paneer pakoda is a popular Indian snack made with paneer coated in a besan batter and deep-fried until crispy. It's a delicious appetizer. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Mutton Aalni Soup
info.description: Delicious mutton soup preparation. Boneless mutton pieces cooked in flavourful mutton stock, garnished with fresh coriander. Highly recomanded before a loaded mutton meal. (Portion: serves - 1)

info.name: Chicken Aalni Soup
info.description: Simple,tasty chicken soup preparation. It's a Maharashtrian style of soup which has a boneless chicken pieces in it. This healthy protein soup is very popular before the heavy non-veg meal. (Portion: serves - 1)

info.name: Pandhra Rassa
info.description: Traditional Maharashtrian dish, The name "Pandhara Rassa" translates to "White soupy curry" in Marathi. It is a flavorful and mildly spiced that made with mutton stock water. Many people love to have this as a soup before the heavy meal. (Portion: serves - 1)

info.name: Tambda Rassa
info.description: Tambda Rassa is a red soupy curry that hails from the Kolhapur district of maharashtra. It is known for its rich flavors. The word "tambda" in Marathi means red, and "rassa" refers to a soupy curry. (Portion: serves - 1)

info.name: Veg Soup
info.description: Very comforting soup with mixed vegetables. A cup of soup is a great meal starter also a tasty, nutritious selection before any meal. (Portion: serves - 1)

info.name: Kaala Chicken Fry
info.description: One of our signature preperation, made by using black masala, tossed along with green chillies & fresh coriander. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Chicken Kharda Fry
info.description: Chicken starter made by cooking the dish in Kolhapuri Pandhra Rassa & Kharda together, Indeed one of the favorite pick for food lovers. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Chicken Fry
info.description: Delicious chicken starter made in homemade red masala, can be enjoyed on its own as a starter Or with the main course. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Chicken Ukkad
info.description: Super delicious, super healthy pick, mild on taste chicken preperation. It has a chicken pieces cooked in delicious clear soup. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Chicken Aalni Fry
info.description: Healthy & Nutricious selection, mild on taste chicken preperation. Recommended for health concious diners. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Kaala Mutton Fry
info.description: One of our signature preperation, made by using black masala, tossed along with green chillies & fresh coriander. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Mutton Kharda Fry
info.description: Mutton starter made by cooking the dish in Kolhapuri Pandhra Rassa & Kharda together, Indeed one of the favorite pick for food lovers. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Mutton Ukkad
info.description: Super delicious, super healthy pick, mild on taste mutton preperation. It has a mutton pieces cooked in delicious clear soup. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Mutton Fry
info.description: Delicious mutton starter made in homemade red masala, can be enjoyed on its own as a starter Or with the main course. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Mutton Aalni Fry
info.description: Healthy & Nutricious selection, mild on taste mutton preperation. Recommended for health concious diners. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Chops Fry
info.description: Tender pieces of mutton chops cooked in homemade red masala, can be enjoyed on its own as a starter Or with the main course. (Portion: 4 Pieces)

info.name: Chops Aalni Fry
info.description: Healthy & Nutricious selection, mild on taste mutton chops preperation. Recommended for health concious diners. (Portion: 4 Pieces)

info.name: Surmai Tawa Fry
info.description: Surmai Tawa Fry is a super tasty seafood preparation made by using marinated surmai slices coated with masala and then directly shallow fried in a pan. (Portion: 2 Slices)

info.name: Pomfret Tawa Fry
info.description: Pomfret Tawa Fry is a super tasty seafood preparation made by using marinated whole pomfret coated with masala and then directly shallow fried in a pan. (Portion: 250gms Pomfret)

info.name: Pomfret Rawa Fry
info.description: Pomfret Rawa Fry is a delicious and crispy seafood dish made by using marinated whole pomfret coated in a semolina (rawa) and then shallow fried. (Portion: 250gms Pomfret)

info.name: Surmai Rawa Fry
info.description: Surmai Rawa Fry is a delicious and crispy seafood dish made by using marinated surmai slices coated in a semolina (rawa) and then shallow fried. (Portion: 2 Slices)

info.name: Prawns Thecha Fry
info.description: Fresh Prawns tossed in green chillies & garlic thecha, with dash of lime juice and garnished with fresh coriander leaves. Super favorite starter of all foodies. (Portion: 10-12 Prawns)

info.name: Prawns Rawa Fry
info.description: Prawns Rawa Fry is a delicious and crispy seafood dish made by using marinated prawns coated in a semolina (rawa) and then deep fried. (Portion: 10-12 Prawns)

info.name: Pomfret Koliwada
info.description: Speciality of coastal region of Maharashtra. Cut pieces of marinated pomfret fish coated with mixed flour batter and then deep fried. This preparation is unique and tangy in flavour. (Portion: 250gms Pomfret)

info.name: Surmai Koliwada
info.description: Speciality of coastal region of Maharashtra. Boneless pieces of marinated Surmai fish coated with mixed flour batter and then deep fried. This preparation is unique and tangy in flavour. (Portion: 6-8 Boneless Pieces )

info.name: Prawns Koliwada
info.description: Speciality of coastal region of Maharashtra. Fresh masala marinated prawns coated with mixed flour batter and then deep fried. This preparation is unique and tangy in flavour. (Portion: 10-12 Prawns)

info.name: Kaala Chicken Handi
info.description: As the name suggests this curry is slightly black appearance, made by fine roasting of Onions, dry coconut & regional masalas. Kaala Chicken handi is spicier than our regular chicken handi. It is indeed a super pick for food diners. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Chicken Handi
info.description: Maharashtrian-style Chicken Handi, semi thick curry preparation with great flavors made by using regional spices and ingredients. Goes excellent with chapati, bhakri Or any rice preparation. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Chicken Kadhai Masala
info.description: Its a delicious and aromatic dish that combines the flavors of masalas with the tenderness of chicken and the crunchiness of vegetables like Capsicum, Onion & Tomatoes. Curd is used to create the tangyness, kasuri methi & fresh coriander leaves also adds amazing flavours to this dish. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Mutton Handi
info.description: Maharashtrian-style Mutton Handi, semi thick curry preparation with great flavors made by using regional ingredients. Goes excellent with chapati, bhakri Or any rice preparation. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Kaala Mutton Handi
info.description: As the name suggests this curry is slightly black appearance, made by fine roasting of Onions, dry coconut & regional masalas. It is indeed a super pick for food diners. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Mutton Chops Masala
info.description: Mutton chops pieces cooked in rich and aromatic maharashtrian masala. Our homemade spices & fresh coriander leaves adds amazing flavours to this dish. (Portion: 4 Pieces)

info.name: Mutton Kadhai Masala
info.description: Its a delicious and aromatic dish that combines the flavors of spices with the tenderness of mutton and the crunchiness of vegetables like Capsicum, Onion & Tomatoes. Curd is used to create the tangyness, kasuri methi & fresh coriander leaves also adds amazing flavours to this dish. (Portion: 6 Pieces)

info.name: Kheema & Prawns Fry
info.description: One of our signature innovation, prawns and mutton mince cooked in red gravy, It is quite a flavourful dish. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Kheema & Mutton Fry
info.description: Specially for those who love mutton minced and bone pieces mixed together, delicious dish as a main course. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Kheema Masala
info.description: Minced goat meat cooked in rick red gravy, Super delicious & flavourful. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Kheema Fry
info.description: Kheema Fry is a flavorful dish made with minced goat meat, can be enjoyed as a main course with our Chapati / Bhakri. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Kheema & Egg Fry
info.description: Kheema Fry topped up with half fried eggs, one of everyones favorite. (Portion: serves - 2)

info.name: Egg Curry
info.description: Egg curry is a comforting dish made by using boiled eggs cooked in a flavorful red curry. (Portion: 3 Eggs)

info.name: Egg Bhurji Dry
info.description: Egg bhurji is a popular dish made with scrambled eggs, onions, tomatoes, and various spices. It's a quick and easy dish to prepare, can be enjoyed with bread or roti. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Egg Bhurji Curry
info.description: Lightly sauted egg bhurji cooked in a flavorful red curry and garnished with coriander. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Egg Half Fry
info.description: Half-fried eggs, also known as sunny-side-up eggs, a popular item amonst many. In this dish egg is fried on one side only, leaving the yolk runny and the white partially cooked & then spices and salt sprinkled over the top. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Egg Omelette
info.description: An egg omelette is a dish made by beating eggs and then frying them in a pan with various ingredients such as Onion, Tomatoes, Green Chillies, Coriander & Spices. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Surmai Curry
info.description: Surmai Malvani Curry is a delicious fish curry originating from the Malvan region of Maharashtra, India. Malvani cuisine is known for its bold flavors, often using coconut, masala's, and fresh seafood. (Portion: 2 Slices of Surmai in curry)

info.name: Pomfret Curry
info.description: Pomfret Malvani Curry is a delicious curry originating from the Malvan region of Maharashtra, India. Malvani cuisine is known for its bold flavors, often using coconut, masala's, and fresh seafood. (Portion: 250gms Pomfret pieces in curry)

info.name: Prawns Curry
info.description: Prawns Malvani Curry is a delicious curry originating from the Malvan region of Maharashtra, India. Malvani cuisine is known for its bold flavors, often using coconut, masala's and fresh seafood. (Portion: 10-12 Prawns pieces in curry)

info.name: Wangi Batata Rassa
info.description: Wangi Batata Rassa is a delicious Maharashtrian curry made with brinjal and potatoes in a homemade red gravy. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Pithla
info.description: One of the most popular Maharashtrian dish, Pithla is made from besan (gram flour), mild spices and water, cooked to a thick & creamy consistency. Simple & delicious preperation. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Shev Bhaji
info.description: Shev Bhaji is a popular Maharashtrian dish made with thick Shev cooked in a delicious and tangy curry. It's a flavorful and satisfying dish. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Paneer Bhurji Dry
info.description: Paneer Bhurji is a popular dish made with crumbled paneer (cottage cheese) cooked with onions, tomatoes, and spices. It's quick and incredibly flavorful. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Matki Fry
info.description: Dry version of Matki Usal, Matki Fry is a simple and delicious dish made with sprouted moth beans (matki) sautéed with homemade masalas (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Paneer Bhurji Curry
info.description: Cooked Paneer Bhurji is mixed with Veg handi gravy finished with spices and fresh coriander leaves. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Batata Rassa Bhaaji
info.description: Batata Rassa Bhaji is a popular local dish made with potatoes cooked in a flavorful gravy. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Matki Usal
info.description: Matki Usal is a popular Maharashtrian dish made from sprouted moth beans (matki). It's a flavorful and nutritious curry dish. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Dal Tadka
info.description: Dal Tadka is a popular dish consisting of cooked lentils tempered with spices and herbs. It's known for its aromatic tempering (tadka) of spices in oil, which is added to the cooked lentils, giving it a distinctive flavor to the dish. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Batata Sukki Bhaaji
info.description: Dry potato dish with tempering of Cumin, mustard seeds, mild spices and garnished with coriander leaves. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Dal Kolhapuri
info.description: It’s a flavorful lentil dish originating from the Kolhapur region of Maharashtra. known for its rich and aromatic flavors, great choice for food lovers. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Dal Lasooni
info.description: Dal Lasooni is a flavorful and aromatic lentil dish infused with the rich taste of garlic (lasoon). It's a popular dish, known for its robust flavors and comforting appeal. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Dahi Pithla
info.description: Dahi Pithla is a traditional dish from the state of Maharashtra. It is a delicious preparation made with chickpea flour (besan) and yogurt (dahi), tasty & mildly tangy in taste. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Dal Fry
info.description: It is a popular Indian dish made from lentils (dal) cooked with spices and then tempered with oil. It's a comforting and flavorful dish. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Butter Dal Fry
info.description: It is a rich and indulgent variation of the traditional Dal Fry, where butter is added to enhance the flavor and creaminess of the dish. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Lasooni Methi
info.description: Lasooni Methi, also known as garlic-flavored fenugreek leaves, It combines the earthy flavor of methi with the aromatic taste of garlic (lasoon). (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Matki Methi Fry
info.description: Soaked matki cooked with onions, tomatoes, and boiled fenugreek leaves then finished with spices and coriander leaves. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Methi Pithla
info.description: Methi Pithla is a variation of the traditional Maharashtrian dish Pithla, where methi (fenugreek leaves) are added to enhance flavor and nutrition. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Paneer Methi
info.description: Paneer Methi is a delicious Vegetarian mains dish made with paneer (cottage cheese) and fenugreek leaves (methi). (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Non Veg Curry
info.description: ONLY Curry cooked in Non-Veg stock, it has NO Pieces in it. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Veg Curry
info.description: ONLY Curry cooked in Veg stock, it has NO vegetables in it. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Mutton Tawa Biryani
info.description: Mutton Tawa Biryani is a flavorful and aromatic one-pot dish where mutton (goat meat) and rice are cooked together with a blend of spices on a tawa (griddle) to create a delicious biryani. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Chicken Tawa Biryani
info.description: Chicken Tawa Biryani is a flavorful and aromatic one-pot dish where Chicken and rice are cooked together with a blend of spices on a tawa (griddle) to create a delicious biryani. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Boneless Mutton Pulao
info.description: Its  flavorful and comforting dish that can be enjoyed on its own, Boneless mutton pieces tossed with rice & other spices. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Indrayani Rice
info.description: Indrayani rice is a aromatic rice that is popular in maharashtra. Like other varieties of rice, Indrayani rice is a staple food in many parts of India and is widely consumed in both everyday meals and festive occasions. (FULL : serves 2) (HALF : serves 1)

info.name: Boneless Chicken Pulao
info.description: Its  flavorful and comforting dish that can be enjoyed on its own, Boneless Chicken pieces tossed with rice & other spices. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Aalni Bhaat
info.description: Aalni Bhaat is a delicious and nutritious dish that showcases the mild regional flavors, In this dish Indrayani Rice is cooked by using mutton stock water. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Egg Tawa Biryani
info.description: Egg Tawa Biryani is a flavorful and aromatic one-pot dish where Eggs and rice are cooked together with a blend of masalas on a tawa (griddle) to create a delicious biryani. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Egg Bhurji Pulao
info.description: Egg Bhurji Pulao is a delightful dish that combines the scrambled eggs (known as Bhurji) with aromatic rice to create a satisfying meal. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Veg Pulao
info.description: Popular Indian rice dish made by cooking basmati rice with assorted vegetables and aromatic spices, served with veg curry. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Dal Khichdi
info.description: Dal Khichdi is a comforting meal made with rice, lentils, and aromatic spices, sprinkled with fresh coriander leaves. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Dahi Bhaat
info.description: Dahi Bhaat is known as Curd Rice, is a popular Indian dish made from rice and yogurt (curd).  It's a soothing and cooling dish, perfect for hot summer days, and it's also a comfort food for many. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Jeera Rice
info.description: It’s a popular rice dish made by cooking basmati rice with cumin seeds (jeera) and other aromatic spices. It's a flavorful and fragrant rice dish. (FULL : serves 2) (HALF : serves 1)

info.name: Mutton Combo Meal
info.description: Mutton Curry (4 Pieces), 2 Chapati / 1 Bhakri, Indrayani Rice / Aalni Bhaat, Shrikhand, Kanda & Limbu.

info.name: Chicken Combo Meal
info.description: Chicken Curry (4 Pieces), 2 Chapati / 1 Bhakri, Indrayani Rice / Aalni Bhaat, Shrikhand, Kanda & Limbu.

info.name: Sukkat Chutney
info.description: Its a dried shrimps

info.name: Dahi Kanda Plate
info.description: Sliced onion mixed with curd, coriander leaves & salt is added as per the taste. Dahi kanda is often eaten as a side dish in maharashtra. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Mirchi Thecha
info.description: It’s a popular side dish / chutney originating from the state of Maharashtra. It is typically made by crushing green chillies, garlic, coriander leaves, cumin seed and then salt & lemon juice is added. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Boondi Raita
info.description: Popular variation of raita made with salted boondi (fried chickpea flour balls). It's a delightful and refreshing side dish, tastes excellent with biryani or pulao dishes. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Veg Raita
info.description: Vegetable raita is a popular yogurt-based side dish that is often taste great with spicy main dishes like biryani or curry. It's made by mixing yogurt with various chopped vegetables and mixed spices. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Salad Plate
info.description: Freshly sliced vegetables like Onion, Tomatoes, Cucumber, Lemon etc. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Dahi Plate
info.description: Plain yogurt served with small portion of sugar. (Portion: serves 2)

info.name: Bhakri
info.description: It is made from Jawar flour, warm water, and salt. The dough is rolled into thick rotis and cooked on a hot griddle. (Size: 10 inches)

info.name: Butter Bhakri
info.description: It is made from Jawar flour, warm water, and salt. The dough is rolled into thick rotis and cooked on a hot griddle. After cooking it, butter is applied on inner side of the bhakri. (Size: 10 inches)

info.name: Chapati
info.description: It is made from whole wheat flour, water, and salt. The dough is rolled into thin rotis and cooked on a hot griddle. (Size: 10 inches)

info.name: Butter Chapati
info.description: It is made from whole wheat flour, water, and salt. The dough is rolled into thin rotis and cooked on a hot griddle. After cooking it, butter is applied on inner side of the chapati. (Size: 10 inches)

info.name: Caramel Custard
info.description: Eggless preperation, It is also known as crème caramel. A classic dessert consisting of a smooth, creamy custard topped with a layer of caramelized sugar. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Shrikhand
info.description: Popular dessert made from strained yogurt, sugar, and various flavorings such as saffron, cardamom & nutmeg. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Rabdi
info.description: Traditional selection made by simmering milk until it reduces to a thick consistency.  Rich, creamy, and flavorful dessert. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Solkadhi
info.description: Traditional coastal region drink made from kokum and coconut milk. It is indeed a refreshing beverage. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Mattha
info.description: Drink made from yogurt (curd) mixed with chilled water and flavored with crushed ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander leaves and salt to taste. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Lime Juice
info.description: Freshly squeezed lemon juice added to chilled water, salt & sugar is added to taste. It is known for its refreshing taste and for health benefits. (Portion: serves 1)

info.name: Mineral Water
info.description: 1 Ltr. Mineral Water Bottle.
